title: Gradient-boosted model predicts euploid versus aneuploid pregnancy loss from clinical data
summary: A gradient boosted model using 45 clinical predictors was developed in 788 women with pregnancy loss in a prospective Copenhagen cohort, with ploidy determined by cell-free fetal DNA, and validated in two other hospitals (n = 229 and n = 199). Cross-validated AUC was 0.69 (95% CI 0.65-0.73) with similar external performance; at 90% specificity sensitivity was 54.4%, 47% and 48%. Key predictors were maternal, gestational and paternal age, BMI and vitamin D and E supplementation; discrimination is moderate and the authors call for further validation.
